lyrics: All charanams to be sung similar to pallavi
charanam 2 - sthira chittamu vara chAmI-kara pITamu raghunAtha
charanam 3 - sumukha dhyAnamu gangA ja-lamaurA raghunAtha
charanam 4 - ibha pAlaka abhimAnamu shubha chElamu raghunAtha
charanam 5 - ghana kIrthini balkE vA-sana gandhamu raghunAtha
charanam 6 - hari nAma smaraNambulu viruthAmara raghunAtha
charanam 7 - tholi dushkrtha phalamElla - guggulu dhUpamu raghunAtha
charanam 8 - nIpAda bhakthE proddhunu dIpambagu raghunAtha
charanam 9 - nE jEyu supUjA phalamu bhOjanamavu raghunAtha
charanam 10 - eDabAyani nAyEDa galgu sukhamu viDamaurA raghunAtha
charanam 11 - nInu jUchuTE ghana dIpArA dhanamurA raghunAtha
charanam 12 - pUjA vidhi naija tyAga-rAja krthamu raghunAtha
